critique: The render now has several visible soft pink blobs and a pleasing diffuse glow on black, which is closer than the prior single-disc result. However, the blobs remain fused into one compact, nearly circular central mass. From t1 to t4 the cluster mainly fills in and grows denser rather than reading as a spatially dispersed field of independently drifting light blobs. The composition still lacks the broader, airy distribution and gentle motion implied by the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Widen the grid emitter horizontally so blobs occupy a broader area rather than merging into one central clump.
Increase vertical emitter extent as well, producing a loose two-dimensional blob field instead of a compact circular cluster.
Reduce continuous particle creation so later frames do not simply become a fuller solid mass; individual blobs should remain legible.
Slightly reduce maximum blob size after spreading the emitter, preserving distinct soft light circles rather than heavy overlap.
